species.name: Curlop
species.summary: An upright crescent of dense fur: a round head end, a cream belly, two stout hind feet, a long curled tail, and two small three-fingered hands held together at the chest (a free front pair over a contact hind pair).

taxonomy.resembles: an upright crescent with a curled tail and small hands
taxonomy.ability: draft: to be set by the game designer

signature.feature: a curled tail and two small three-fingered hands held at the chest; the fiddlehead of the ferns

typeSpecimen.rule: every open part switch on; an open locus at the species' typical copies where the frame names them (its proportions by kind), else numeric loci at the middle of their pool and categorical loci at the first allele
typeSpecimen.brief: Curlop: 1 body region (B1), a head, a snout, 2 eyes, 2 legs, a tail; fur, bands; upright, fused head.

viability.rule: random copies from the species pools at every open locus, and children of crosses between members (their blends on the step between the named alleles); built by the rig and validated against the compositional contract
